name: security
description: Skills for the defensive side of shipping software: review a change for the vulnerability classes that actually get exploited, reduce who can do what toward least privilege without breaking production, rotate or contain a credential, harden a container image and keep checking it, read a Terraform plan for what it destroys, preserve evidence and build an intrusion timeline after a compromise, respond to credential stuffing, write and test detection rules, prove tenant isolation, and handle vulnerability reports from outside researchers.
